promise.title: What if your team
promise.body1: Mendly gives every solo founder what only funded startups have: a real team.
promise.body2: Eight specialists who remember every decision, challenge every assumption, and ship real deliverables — every day, for as long as your project lives.

howItWorks.title: Four steps.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Tell us your project in 8 questions. Sector, stage, goals, blockers. Takes 60 seconds.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Your AI team is composed based on your project's needs. Tech-first gets a stronger CTO. Consumer-first gets a stronger CMO.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Your team works, debates, and ships. Weekly sprints. Daily updates. Real deliverables: memos, specs, pitch decks, code.
howItWorks.step4Desc: When you're ready for a real team, we write the job posts ourselves. Your AI team trained your human one.

team.title: Eight specialists.
team.sub: Each agent is trained to simulate 10+ years of expertise in their field. They have their own methods, biases, and tools. They don't agree on everything. That's the point.
